description: It reads what the test address of a webhook really received, straight from that service: for each delivery the time, the method and the exact content that was sent. Take it after a test delivery, when a host wants to see the content itself. "Show me what actually arrived." You give the webhook id from the list. It never touches the receiving system of the host. It only reads and changes nothing. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: webhook payload, delivery log, what arrived, test webhook

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webhook_id.description: The webhook id, as wi_list_webhooks returned it.

name: wi_read_webhook_deliveries
title: Read what a webhook's test address received
